name: Saginuma Rieko
source:
Likes: the Aquarium, qualifications, research
Dislike: sweets, old-fashioned thinking

Rieko is Aquarium staff. She has a good figure like a model, but her makeup and hair style make her look rigid.
She is quite familiar with not only biology, but also management and marketing.

[Taken from [url=http://shizuku.aiueokompany.com/]Official Website[/url]]
